title: This ‘NBA Jam’ Arcade Cabinet Lets You Play the Retro Basketball Game at Home
summary: The vintage-inspired machine stands 5 feet tall and lets you play NBA Jam, NBA Tournament Edition & NBA Jam Hang Time.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The 2026-27 NBA season is upon us, and while there are plenty of games to check out in person this year, basketball fans can also take their fandom home with them with a nostalgic arcade game that harks back to game rooms and amusement parks of the past.

Amazon and Walmart are selling this NBA Jam Deluxe Two-Player Home Arcade Machine , which brings the action and excitement of the ’90s video game into 2026.

GREAT FOR GAME ROOM OR DEN

ARCADE1UP NBA JAM Deluxe 2-Player Home Arcade Machine

$549.99

Buy Now On Amazon

Buy Now AT WALMART

The vintage-inspired machine stands more than five-feet tall and lets you play Midway Games’ NBA Jam, NBA Tournament Edition and NBA Jam Hang Time from the comforts of home.

Choose from one- or two-player action, with the ability to hoop, jump and dunk just like the original video game. The built-in joystick control panel also includes buttons to block, pass and steal, and there’s even a button you can press for “turbo” mode. The retro-style graphics appear on a crisp 17-inch, full-color screen. Built-in speakers are surprisingly loud so you can experience all the sound effects and fan noise from the game.

While you may still have to drop a dollar or two to play this NBA Jam game at an actual arcade these days, the at-home version is strictly plug-and-play — no coins required. Still, the cabinet features a faux coin panel with the nostalgic light-up red “push” buttons.

This is an officially licensed release from Arcade1Up, the manufacturer known for its re-creation of classic arcade games. The NBA Jam stand-up arcade game is a great pickup for a game room, basement or den (and I’m personally pushing for our facilities team to bring this to the Billboard offices), though you’ll want to make note of the measurements: The cabinet measures approximately 61.5 x 18.6 x 18.4 in size, with a weight of just over 61 pounds.

DESKTOP VERSION

Arcade1Up NBA JAM Countercade

$122

Need something for a smaller space? Walmart also sells this countertop version of the arcade game, with a seven-inch LCD display, along with a similar joystick and buttons.

This set also lets you play NBA Jam, NBA Tournament Edition and NBA Jam Hang Time, and it’s powered via batteries (not included) or USB cable.

The Arcade1Up NBA Jam consoles arrive as the league kicks off another season. The New York Knicks took home the Larry O’Brien Championship Trophy last year, defeating the San Antonio Spurs in the 2026 NBA Finals.
